why: Campfires burn brighter and wider, and longer on each later day, instead of the old campfire.

components.burnTicks: number: ticks a campfire burns before it dies down, on the campfire
components.burnLeft: number: ticks of burning left, on a lit campfire
components.flame: number: id of the campfire's flame entity, on the campfire
components.flameOf: number: id of the campfire a flame belongs to, on the flame
components.fadeTween: number: id of the tween fading a dying campfire's light, on the campfire
